questions.question: When do we use "will"?
questions.explanation: "Will" is used for instant decisions: "Ill get the phone!"

questions.question: When do we use "going to"?
questions.explanation: "Going to" is used for plans already decided: "Im going to visit my grandma."

questions.question: Fill in: "Look at those clouds! It ___ rain."
questions.explanation: Use "going to" for predictions based on evidence (you can see the clouds).

questions.question: Which is an instant decision?
options: The phone is ringing - Ill get it!
questions.explanation: Answering the phone is decided at that moment - instant decision = "will".

questions.question: Which is correct?
questions.explanation: After "will", use the base form of the verb: "I will help."
